" local card(s). Hold OK on a card for its long-press action."
" · source enabled. Updated when Home opens, without page reloads."
" — kept, but HA source is active"
"APK downloaded and checked. You can now start Android installation."
"Enable linking below to make this TV appear in the HA editor."
"Enable linking on the TV, then refresh this list. Never enter a token in this editor."
"Fit to area fills the slot. If too small, text and icons shrink together without distortion. Original YAML stays intact. Native cards already follow their slot."
"Assignment saved. Other TVs keep their profile."
"Show the HA dashboard button in Home"
"Adjust the density and visual appearance of the home screen."
"Android System WebView unavailable. Update it in the Play Store. Back: Home"
"Android must allow TV Assistant to read continue-watching content shared by your apps. Access is read-only; no history is changed. You can decline and keep using the launcher."
"Press the button to assign. Back to cancel."

"Assist uses the TV account and its permissions. Transcription uses the installed Android speech service, not HA\'s STT engine. No continuous listening. Text input remains available without a speech service. The third service opens a voice app or an HTTPS address with {query}. No HA token is sent; do not put secrets in the address."
"Tabs scroll with the remote when space runs out. Apps must be installed on the TV."
"No browser available. Open the displayed link on a computer."
"No tabs. The logo and Menu button still open settings."
"No file picker available. Use Copy or Share."
"No sharing app available. Use Copy or Save."
"Current features do not require full storage, accessibility or notification permissions. Photos are selected with Android\'s file picker."
"No button received. Some buttons are reserved by the TV."
"No newer version at the last successful check."
"Approval required · an administrator must assign a profile to this TV in HA"
"Fixed navigation bar, block positions, sizes and colors"
"Unsent draft: the image still shows the version applied on the TV."
"HA card not loaded · OK: sign in or retry"
"HA card validated. Save to send it to the TV."

"Native or real Home Assistant cards: paste an HA card\'s YAML to preserve its styles, animations and actions. Required HACS resources must already be installed in HA. Cards use the non-admin TV account token; a separate web login remains available as fallback. Place cards in Layout → Free placement."
"Native cards · visual and YAML editor · live HA states without a web page"
"This profile is still assigned to a TV. Assign that TV to another profile or remove its connection before deleting the profile."
"This system does not offer this screen. ADB setup may be required; no changes were made."
"Invalid HA certificate for this address. Use its valid HTTPS name. Back: Home"
"Invalid HA certificate · check the HTTPS address"
"Different signing certificate: update refused. Do not uninstall your launcher."
"These settings affect only the navigation bar, never the cards."
"This Android screen is unavailable. Use system settings or the official release page."
"This screen shows the last observed status. The HA preview may be offline while settings are open."
"This button remains reserved for navigation or the system."
"Every permission is your choice. The app never removes or disables a launcher."
"Loading HA… · Arrows: pointer · OK: click · CH ±: scroll · Menu: options · Back: Home"
"Choose TV Assistant as your home screen"
"Choosing a color activates Solid color in the draft. No photo gradients; dimming remains adjustable. For light colors, also adjust text colors."
"Choose the service for this request. Listening has not started."
"Choose the visible rows, as in Projectivy."
"Choose the background atmosphere without fictional content."
"Choose a card to edit, or add one."
"Choose a color or create your own. Changes apply only when you choose Use this color."
"Click a frame in the screen to adjust it."
"Start with the emulator. Each TV can have its own profile or share another TV\'s profile."
"Launcher behavior, displayed information and Android apps."
"Configure the HA address and dashboard path."
"Conflict: this profile has changed. Reload it before deleting."
"Connection removed. The Home Assistant token has not been revoked."
"HA web login required · OK to sign in"
"Keep a local copy of your layout or restore the original settings."

"Exact report contents. No raw logs, tokens, addresses, names, profiles, photos or history. HA status is the last observed on the home screen, not a new connection test. Nothing is sent automatically."
"Convert blocks into movable cards in the draft without running actions. {greeting} automatically follows the TV time. Existing cards are not overwritten."
"Copy the latest HA file into the local editor"
"Create cards in Home Assistant → Custom cards and native dashboard"
"In HA: Settings → Dashboards → Add → New dashboard. Name it TV, add cards, open its view and copy only the path (e.g. /dashboard-tv/tv)."
"In HA → TV Assistant → TVs, compare the identifier below, then assign a saved profile using your admin account."
"In Android settings, allow TV Assistant to install this update. Then return here and choose Install. You may revoke this permission after installation."
"Native slideshow from a shared Google Photos album. Unofficial reader, no Google account in the launcher."
"Layout, fixed navigation bar, sizes and colors"
"HA data: connection lost or server unreachable"
"HA data: not yet checked from the home screen"
"Uncheck an app to hide it. Choose favorites by holding OK in the Apps tab."
"Blue-green gradient · automatic colors by mode · one rotation every 2 seconds when frequency is above 0 Hz. Animation also respects system settings."
"Clear this TV\'s token and web session"
"Live · OK to open · Hold for actions"
"Unable to save securely. No new token was accepted."
"Not enough free space for the update."
"Optional: only hide blocks in For you. Apps and Home pages remain available. Re-enable blocks in Appearance and Rows."
"Favorites in order: Android packages, one per line"
"Favorites, apps and placed shortcuts. Filled icons without outlines."
"File on the same HA server (.yaml or .json)"
"Arrows: pointer · OK: click / hold · CH ±: scroll · Back: launcher"
"Solid background: photo gradients do not apply. Dimming is adjustable in Wallpaper. For a light color, also adjust text colors."
"Icon shape in favorites and apps, card size and spacing."
"GitHub is temporarily limiting requests. Try again later."
"GitHub receives your IP address, but no HA token or TV identifier. Downloads happen only on request. Installation requires your Android approval and preserves settings."
"Drag frames; drag the bottom-right corner to resize. Arrows: move by 1%, Shift + arrows: resize. Frames are not part of the screenshot."
"HA unreachable. Check network and address. Menu: retry · Back: Home"
"HA · Sign in if prompted · Arrows: pointer · OK: click · CH ±: scroll · Menu: options · Back: Home"
"HTTPS and a valid certificate are required. The token is encrypted with Android Keystore and excluded from backups. Use a non-admin TV account."
"Home Assistant is not responding. Try again; your draft is kept."

"Offline means the editor no longer receives the launcher connection. The TV may be asleep, in another app, or have linking disabled or refused. HA alone cannot determine the cause: check the link status on the TV."
"Here, with your admin account: create and save a profile, check the TV identifier, select that profile and click “Assign this profile”. Several TVs can share a profile."
"Custom image already imported on the TV"
"Real image of the version applied on the TV."
"Import this YAML as a real HA card"
"Import this TV\'s settings into the draft"
"Android installer unavailable. Use the official release page or try again."
"Installation cancelled or refused by Android. Your settings are preserved."
"Install TV Assistant through HACS, restart HA, then add the integration in Settings → Devices & services. Return to the TV home screen."
"Install the TV Assistant integration in HA, then enable the connection here."
"Protected token saved · leave empty to keep"
"Configuration changed while editing. Go back and reopen the card to avoid overwriting changes."
"The Home Assistant connection will be kept."
"The connection was removed in HA. Disable linking to remain in local mode, or return home and approve this TV again in HA."
"The latest release does not contain a stable APK."

"The full list is read in pages. Only photos to display are downloaded at TV size. The cache replaces older copies. Offline, only cached photos are shown. Synchronization runs while the launcher is visible and resumes when it opens."
"Android TV continue watching is not available on this device."
"The available version has changed. Check for updates again."
"The Android service transcribes speech, then sends the text to your HA agent using this TV\'s account."
"Current local YAML will be replaced and kept as Previous version. The HA file will not be changed."
"The draft will be replaced. Nothing is saved until you confirm."
"The slideshow will be disabled. Google Photos originals will not be deleted."
"The HA file is active. Local changes do not erase this file."
"The token belongs to a different account from the original pairing. Check the account, then use “Pair this TV again” if the change was intentional."
"This HA version\'s Lovelace engine is not accessible. Open an HA dashboard, then retry."
"The HA profile takes priority during synchronization. To keep changes, also update Layout or Appearance in HA."
"The HA panel profile takes priority. Local cards and the HA file are kept."
"HA cards, long-press menus and the home screen work without this permission. It does not replace the default launcher. Open Android settings to allow it?"
"HA data and the editor use two separate connections. The profile is synchronized while the launcher is on its home screen; another app or sleep may interrupt the preview."
"Icons fit the available space. Reduce the number of columns or rows to make them larger. Home screen favourites are unchanged."
"Photos remain a native slideshow. Albums are checked only while home is visible. Import custom images on each TV. The shared album link is stored in HA: do not publish the YAML export."
"Settings are kept. The token is not revoked in HA; enter it again to reconnect this TV."
"Google Photos album link (anyone with the link can view it)"
"The APK and the HACS integration are updated separately."
"The APK will be downloaded from the official repository, then its checksum, version and certificate will be checked. Android will ask you to confirm installation. No settings will be erased."
"The HA address has changed. Check it, then update the link below; do not create a new pairing unless the account has changed."
"Line order sets favorite order. Apps missing from a TV are ignored on that TV."

"Home keeps its native cards. Enable the button and enter the TV dashboard path. The first opening uses the normal HA web login; no launcher token is injected. Installed HACS cards work in this web view depending on Android WebView compatibility."
"Update the APK and check the profile in the HA editor. The last valid display is preserved."
"Same heat pump logic: defrost, circulation, mode and frequency. No JavaScript is executed."
"New TV pending: verify its identity, then explicitly assign a profile to authorize access. No profile has been sent yet."
"Only shown when real content is available"
"Open this page on your TV or a computer to download the APK. This button does not start an installation. Keep the same signing certificate to update without losing settings."
"Open Apps on startup (if Home is disabled)"
"Positions use percentages of the free area. Avoid overlaps; Back always reaches the navigation bar."
"For lights, covers and scripts together, use a YAML group such as group.tv_launcher. For lights only, an HA light group also works. Group members become this row\'s cards."
"For multiple commands, add an actions list in YAML mode. HA scripts can combine as many steps as needed."
"HA profile active: also use Wallpaper settings in HA to sync across TVs."
"Profile deleted. Other profiles and TV settings are preserved."
"Profile “{profile}” saved, version {revision}. Sent to connected TVs assigned to this profile; others will receive it when returning home."
"Launcher-only shortcuts. Home, Back, volume and power remain controlled by Android."
"Search cards by name or entity ID"
"Speech recognition unavailable. Enable a compatible Android voice service or type your request."
"Link this launcher to the HA integration to display this card"
"Set the scene in Rows → Quick actions before converting."
"Set both scenes in Rows → Quick actions before converting."
"Restore and send the previous version to this profile\'s TVs? The current draft will be discarded."
"Return to the home screen for a few seconds, then check this status. Also check that HA and the TV use the same instance and that the integration is loaded."
"Settings imported into the draft. Review them, then send the profile."
"No Assist response received. The request may have run: check before sending it again."
"Movie scene to convert into a card"
"Turn-off scene to convert into a card"
"If Google changes its shared pages, synchronization may stop; local copies remain available. Videos are shown as still images."
"Overlay not allowed · optional, the launcher works without it"
"Permanently delete profile “{profile}” and its history? Profiles still assigned to a TV must be detached first. This does not reset any TV."

"Remove connection “{tv}”? Its profile is preserved. The TV keeps its local display and HA token. If linking remains enabled on the TV, it will reappear on its next connection, without approval. To remove it permanently, first disable “Edit from Home Assistant” on the TV."

"On each launcher, open Home Assistant settings → Edit from Home Assistant. Name the TV and enable the connection. Only explicitly linked TVs receive a profile. A TV in standby or another app appears offline; it will sync when returning home."
"On the TV: Launcher settings → Home Assistant. Enter your HA HTTPS address and a non-admin user\'s token, then test the connection."
"On the TV: open “Edit from Home Assistant”, name the TV and enable linking. Return to the launcher home screen."
"TV Assistant: fixed name and white text. The logo always opens settings."
"Unknown TV or not authorized for this HA account"
"TV linked · create or assign a profile in Home Assistant"
"Anyone with this link can view the album. No Google password is requested. Originals are never modified."
"Download failed. Check your network and try again."
"Remote: arrows = pointer, OK = click, CH +/− = scroll, Menu = options, Back = Home cards. No periodic reload. Integration previews do not capture this web view."
"A previous YAML version remains available in the editor."
"Uses the voice search service installed on this TV."
"Validate before saving · the editor runs no actions"
"Validate the YAML of each modified HA card before saving."
"Your local configuration is kept when you enable an HA file."
"Real HA card: edit its YAML in the TV Assistant integration."
"Checks GitHub without an account or TV identifier. Like any connection, GitHub receives your IP address. No automatic downloads or installations."
"Unable to check while offline or the network is unavailable. Try again later."
"Check the integration version and this TV\'s pairing in HA. The TV account should not be made an administrator."
"“Home connected” on the TV means HA data is accessible. It does not confirm the link to this editor: that link must be enabled and approved separately."
"Setup required · choose TV Assistant, then Always if Android offers it."
"TV Assistant editor: paired with another account"
"TV Assistant editor: connection removed in HA"
"TV Assistant editor: integration missing or not loaded"
"TV Assistant editor: profile received and applied"
"Visual editor · advanced options are preserved when switching to YAML"
"← Search · → Back / Save · OK Select / deselect"
"✓ Android is actually using TV Assistant as the home app."
